title: Jamaican Yellow Pepper Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful French-inspired dish featuring marinated yellow peppers, onions, and jamaican seasonings, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: 2. Cut yellow peppers and onions into bite-sized pieces.
3. Thread peppers and onions onto skewers.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and jamaican seasoning.
5. Brush the skewers with the marinade, making sure to coat all the vegetables.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
